To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a framework for proactive performance measurements system introduction is proposed; (2) the performance measures are to be determined by shopfloor employees, not by top management or consultants; and (3) the performance measurements should be designed to drive the production cell towards the requirements of the customer, not towards the requirements of top management.
a proactive performance measurement system can be introduced in a production cell if the cell employees are allowed to choose the performance measures which are to be used in that cell.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the introduction of a proactive performance measurement system in a manufacturing environment.
the design and implementation of performance measurement systems which will drive the shop floor towards the requirements of the customer, and which are run by the shopfloor employees.
developing a framework which will allow a performance measurement system to be introduced in a proactive way.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the framework proposed in this thesis is a viable approach to introducing a performance measurement system which will drive the shop floor towards the requirements of the customer, whilst at the same time generating a positive behavioural change in the shop floor workforce.
the proposed framework will generate a proactive performance measurement system that is capable of improving performance and morale.
a framework for the proactive introduction of a performance measurement system is proposed, which will drive a production cell towards the requirements of the customer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a performance measurement system should be developed by the people it affects and should be used by the people it is developed for.

we have developed a framework for the introduction of a performance measurement system which is designed by shopfloor employees to meet the needs of their customer, which will be run by shopfloor employees, and which will drive the shop-floor towards meeting its customer’s needs.
a proactive performance measurement system can be introduced to the shopfloor by following a structured approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
performance measurement should be seen as a process of continuous improvement, rather than as a one-off event, in which the shopfloor is involved from the beginning and throughout.
the performance measurement system should be designed to be a tool for the shopfloor to use to improve its own performance and to be proactive in the way it is used.
the performance measurement system should be introduced in a manner which will encourage employees to accept and embrace the system.
